title: Amount with currency (research candidate)
reason:
Depth: focused. Confidence high in research distinction, not accepted mapping. Same amount representation is insufficient for price, revenue or balance equivalence. Public dataset coverage/rights require separate discovery. Possible current core comparison: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/money-amount?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97; unresolved scope/representation match.

Phase 2 ACCEPTED: Accepted reuse of core money-amount; this is concept/role reuse, not raw-value or cross-dataset identity equivalence. Money needs currency, amount role and time basis. Core money-amount requires a stated unit; most demo numeric columns lack established currency. Currency entity differs from code, fund and territory assignment. FX requires directed pair, quote kind and observation/publication date. Employees salary currency is unknown. No country-to-transaction-currency inference; no cross-currency totals. Preserve binary-float conversion limits.
practical_value: Same amount representation is insufficient for price, revenue or balance equivalence.
showcase_value: Contextual graph/map/time-series opportunity; practical compatibility remains prerequisite.
